title: Closed comparison for the explicit adic section equivalence
statement: For each prime ℓ and scheme X, use the explicitly constructed comparisonRing and comparisonModuleFunctor of lem-sf-adic-section-module-equivalence. This fixed functor carries the native balanced tensor to the sectionwise sheaf tensor naturally in both variables, sending native pure tensors to sheafified pure tensors. It identifies native internal Hom with the slice-Hom sheaf naturally in both variables, with native evaluation equal to evaluation on the identity slice. The explicitly constructed native bidual transpose of lem-sf-adic-native-bidual sends a section x to the functional z ↦ ev(z,x restricted to W) on every further slice. No restriction-compatibility or equivalence-existence conclusion is asserted here.

proof.text: Obtain the normalized tensor comparison package and the normalized Hom comparison package, then assemble their fields into the stated record.
